exit_codes.2: CONTRACT_ERROR (design invalid / out dir not empty / bad device; nothing trained, no receipt; stdout JSON {status,code})
exit_codes.4: FAILED_UNTYPED unexpected exception (receipt written, code UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION)

subprocess_entry_point.atomic_terminal: RECEIPT.json written last via tmp+rename; its presence is the terminal
subprocess_entry_point.progress: PROGRESS.json rewritten atomically after every epoch: epoch, max_epochs, fit_loss, inner_loss, monitored, stale, best_epoch, updates, elapsed_s, updated_at (unit progress counts epochs; ETA stays UNMEASURED until a full fit completes)

consumed_data_bundle_contract.features: exactly tools.i6n_contracts.feature_availability.MANIFEST_NO_STLFSI4 (19, same order); manifest_sha256 must match
consumed_data_bundle_contract.splits: {fit, inner, validation} -> {path (relative), sha256}; a 'test' split or any origin >= 2025-01-01 is refused (TEST_FORBIDDEN)

split_npz_arrays.row_id: (n,) int64 unique, origin UTC epoch seconds
split_npz_arrays.target_price: (n, 6) float, NaN allowed only where mask is false
split_npz_arrays.mask: (n, 6) bool, per-head business/support mask (C1/C2 computed by lane data)

model_side_defensive_checks: every fit head has >=1 valid label

produced_unit_artifacts.RECEIPT.json: schema i6dmo.train_receipt.v1: status COMPLETED|FAILED_TYPED|FAILED_UNTYPED, code, detail, scientific, overrides, device, identity {design_sha256, effective_config_sha256, bundle_manifest_sha256, feature_manifest_sha256, scales_sha256, weights_sha256, model_archive_sha256, code_files_sha256}, artifacts {relpath: sha256}, training {best_epoch, best_monitored, stop_reason, epochs_completed, updates, early_stop rule}, model_side_summary {fit,inner,validation: per-head count/mae/naive/relative_error, not authoritative}, timings {fit_s, predict_s, wall_s}, resources {cpu_user_s, cpu_sys_s, max_rss_kib, cgroup_memory_peak_bytes|null, tf_gpu_memory_peak_bytes|null, device, visible_gpus, tensorflow_version}
produced_unit_artifacts.model/forecast_model.keras + model/MODEL: restored-best weights; load_dmo reproduces predictions exactly
produced_unit_artifacts.SCALES.json: fit-only input mean/std per feature and per-head fit naive MAE (training coordinate scale)
produced_unit_artifacts.TRAINING.json: per-epoch fit_loss, inner_loss, monitored=0.5*(fit+inner), per-head sums/counts, stale count, weights sha; best_epoch, stop_reason; monitor_evaluation {procedure i6dmo.monitor_eval.v1, batch_size (= training batch), dtype, accumulation} — the DMO10 replay MUST recompute via tools.i6dmo.train.replay_monitored(model, fit, inner, record) (shared evaluate_monitored path; any other batching is MONITOR_PATH_MISMATCH), bitwise on the same device
produced_unit_artifacts.predictions/{fit,inner,validation}.npz: row_id, horizons_hours, origin_price, predicted_price (n,6) original USD/EUR, target_price (NaN where invalid), mask

training_coordinate: y_h = (p(t+h) - p(t)) / naive_fit_h where naive_fit_h = fit-only masked mean |p(t+h)-p(t)|; the per-head loss is therefore exactly MAE_h / naive_fit_h; prediction p_hat = p(t) + yhat_h * naive_fit_h

validate_design.standalone: python -m tools.i6dmo.design validate-design --design <design> [--json]  (exit 0 PASS, 2 FAILED with typed code)
validate_design.shared_cli: ops lane __main__ calls tools.i6dmo.design.add_cli(subparsers); handler sets args.func

fixed_choices_not_in_section_C_declared_.positional_encoding: additive sinusoid at physical offsets -24..0 h (subclass of the plugin PositionalEncoding)
fixed_choices_not_in_section_C_declared_.restore: lowest monitored epoch, first tie; min_delta governs patience only (i6n masked early-stop convention)
fixed_choices_not_in_section_C_declared_.op_determinism: ENABLED everywhere (tf.config.experimental.enable_op_determinism + TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS/TF_CUDNN_DETERMINISTIC) by build_dmo/load_dmo/train_unit/generate_test_predictions; recorded in the receipt ('determinism'), MODEL.json and PREDICTIONS.json; DMO10 save/load identity stays bitwise on the same device; no tolerance was declared (lane 4's bounded GPU replay confirms)

long_family.seal_command: python -m tools.i6dmo seal-long-design --short-design <EXPERIMENT.short.json> --short-terminal <terminals/<id>/TERMINAL.json of short.report> --out <EXPERIMENT.long.json> [--json]  (also python -m tools.i6dmo.design ...); exit 0 SEALED, 2 typed FAILED
long_family.pipeline: seal-long-design (model lane, writes the long design) -> ops `seal-long --root R --design EXPERIMENT.long.json` (campaign sealing) -> long.fit leaves WAIT_ARTIFACT
long_family.short_closure_accepted: terminal schema i6dmo.terminal.v1, unit_id short.report, status COMPLETE|NOT_ELIGIBLE, identity_sha256; only these fields are read (never eligibility/metrics)
long_family.derived: short design + PLAN section 5: experiment_id I6-DMO-LONG-DS12-STATIC-R0, horizons [18,24,36,48,60,72], history_span_hours 144, spacing_hours 12; observations 13, issuance 1 h and every other block mirrored; derived_from {short_design_sha256, short_terminal{unit_id, identity_sha256, terminal_file_sha256}}; seal_sha256 over the body
long_family.deterministic: byte-identical output for the same inputs; idempotent onto an identical file; LONG_DESIGN_EXISTS onto a different one
long_family.undecided: LONG_PLAN_OPEN_FIELDS (currently empty) -> LONG_DESIGN_UNDECIDED: <dotted field>, nothing written; any 'UNDECIDED' value in a long design fails validate-design with the same code
long_family.schema_compat: long design keeps schema i6dmo.design.v1 (ops _design_checks); family is selected by experiment_id; effective config carries family short|long
long_family.trainer: same train entry point; long bundle must declare offsets -144..0 step 12 and horizons 18..72 (BUNDLE_OFFSETS/BUNDLE_HORIZONS otherwise); outputs h18..h72; same masked normalized loss

final_refit.protocol: typed FINAL_REFIT design = design.final_refit_design(validation design): experiment_id + '-FINAL', TRAIN [2021-01-01, 2025-01-01) with the same 8-week inner tail (fit [2021-01-01, 2024-11-06), inner [2024-11-06, 2025-01-01)), validation split removed, sealed; effective mode FINAL_REFIT; FINAL_PLAN_OPEN_FIELDS (empty) -> FINAL_DESIGN_UNDECIDED

final_refit.identity: final design/effective shas differ from validation shas; a validation-era bundle is refused under the final design (SPLIT_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION) and vice versa, so no inherited TRAINED terminal crosses identities; scales fit only on the final TRAIN window; every final sample/label strictly before TEST

final_test_path.module: tools/i6dmo/final.py (model lane), registered as unit_runner HOOKS['final_test'] (replaces the strategy placeholder by registration)
final_test_path.guards: guard_test(root): TEST_READINESS READY; PAIR_VALIDATION/PROCEDURE_FREEZE/DATA_PROVENANCE PASS without TEST reads; PROCEDURE_FREEZE.final_fit_policy must equal the typed FINAL_REFIT; DATA_PROVENANCE.evidence.fred_clocks must resolve fred.rates.dgs3mo.diff_5d and fred.rates.dgs7.logret_5d (not UNVERIFIED/STILL_UNRESOLVED); then guard_execution_policy(root): strategy_adapter.load_execution_policy + execution_from_policy, refusing absent (EXECUTION_POLICY_MISSING) or tampered (EXECUTION_POLICY_TAMPERED) receipts; conventions are never re-derived
final_test_path.test_bundle: build_test_bundle(final_design, {'test': arrays}, out, readiness=guard_test(...)): single test split bound to readiness_sha256 and the final design sha; the ordinary trainer refuses it (TEST_FORBIDDEN)
final_test_path.predictions: generate_test_predictions(final_unit_dir, test_bundle_dir, out, readiness=...): frozen weights + fit-only SCALES reused, design shas must match, writes test.npz (row_id, predicted_price, ...) + PREDICTIONS.json; trained=false
final_test_path.hook: run_unit(spec,...): spec needs campaign_root, upstream_dirs {final.short_refit, final.long_refit}, test_bundles {short, long}; refusals are FAILED with disposition FINAL_BLOCKED_GATE:<code> naming the missing object; backtest delegates to strategy export run_final_backtest(spec, predictions, execution_params, out_dir) (until published: FINAL_BLOCKED_GATE:FINAL_BACKTEST_EXPORT_MISSING with predictions retained)
